description: This PHP source file defines the 'RSSDashlet' class, which extends a Dashlet component for SuiteCRM. It provides functionality to display RSS feeds within the dashboard, including rendering the feed data and configuration options.

classes.name: RSSDashlet
classes.description: A Dashlet subclass that displays RSS feed content with configurable options including URL, height, and refresh interval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the RSSDashlet, loads language strings, and sets default properties based on configuration.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the RSS feed inside the dashlet by fetching RSS data and integrating it with a Smarty template.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Provides a configuration form for the dashlet, allowing users to set the title, URL, height, and auto-refresh options.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Filters and saves user-submitted configuration options for the dashlet.

methods.name: getRSSOutput
methods.description: Fetches and parses RSS data from a provided URL, returning HTML formatted feed entries or an error message.
